about_the_game:
⚔️ The Curse of Trasmoz is the first episode of the Trasmoz Legends trilogy, a dark retro journey that begins on the 8-bit ZX Spectrum, now available on Steam as a seamless, plug & play experience: just double-click and play.


In this single-screen arcade platformer, you are the chosen hero destined to break the curse that has haunted the town of Trasmoz since the 13th century. Night creatures, undead and witches roam the ruins, ruled by the evil sorcerer Mutamin, immortal servant of the devil and master of the tower. Can you purify the land with the fire of wandering souls before sunrise?

Although it runs on a genuine 1982 machine, this version comes bundled with RetroVirtualMachine, offering an authentic 8-bit experience without the technical hurdles. Perfect for veteran players and newcomers alike.

🕹️ Key Features:

- Classic arcade gameplay in single-screen platform levels.
- 3 areas with over 20 handcrafted stages.
- 4 enemy types with unique behaviors and patterns.
- Original soundtrack powered by the AY-3-8912 sound chip.
- Embedded emulator: no setup needed, just click and play!

🧙‍♂️ The legend begins here. Face the night. Free Trasmoz.
